summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the technical requirements for building a service from scratch, specifically concerning ClickHouse implementation. [p1] requested documentation or a schema guide for setting up the entire service using ClickHouse. [me] provided an older, working code repository link (https://github.com/allunite/db/tree/master/ch/db_front), noting that the current 'up-to-date' structure is spread across multiple repositories: [me] handles ClickHouse (ch), and another person handles PostgreSQL (pg). It was confirmed that the PostgreSQL part has been assembled by someone else. As a follow-up, [me] requested assistance in creating an urgent ticket for work to be completed by Wednesday or Thursday.
